method: Session B, from madeira-25.firstlook.json: the 103-frame shortlist at 1000px, 100% crops on 58 subjects and skies (four to an image), the proposed 5★ against the site's six. Ratings below 3 from the first look are in that file, not repeated here.

frames.critique: Charleroi: Le Chat (Geluck) mural "8 MAI" on glass facade, old tower reflected in glass, two walkers below. Witty, very Belgian; reflection adds layer. Busy bottom edge. Slight perspective lean ok.
Charleroi: Le Tonnelier corner, boarded door, brick. Record of decline; flat light, Coca-Cola sign, parking sign right edge. Neat verticals.
Charleroi: Basilique Saint-Christophe dome, square, family walking. Clean establishing frame, blue sky; lot of empty paving bottom third.
Charleroi: Saint-Christophe interior, gold mosaic apse, stained glass, chairs. Rich colour; banner left edge and lamp top intrude, chairs crowd the bottom.
Charleroi: Taverne Sainte Barbe, belfry behind. Pleasant record; Duvel sign. Plain.
Charleroi: town hall belfry over Place Charles II, young tree foreground. Clean, verticals good; empty square, half sky. Establishing.
Funchal Zona Velha: painted door (matryoshka-like figure) with e-scooter, plant pot. Street-art door project; scooter is the joke and the clutter. Nice colour.
Funchal: jacaranda over café terrace, Fortaleza de São Tiago yellow walls, sea. Lovely colour (purple/yellow/blue); busy diners, planter foreground and pink bollard bottom-right cut.

Funchal: cobbled steps up between yellow walls to a flower/banana mural, STOP sign, lamp. Strong leading lines and colour; the STOP sign sits at the vanishing point (blemish, or the joke). Dark wall left a bit heavy.
Funchal seafront: white Fiat Panda parked in front of pergola/sea, woman on bench. Deadpan, half sky empty; car is the subject and it's not interesting enough. Parking sign centre.

Funchal: Igreja do Colégio (or similar) white baroque facade looking up, black basalt trim, statue niche, tree left. Good contrast, white facade holds detail. Corner crop a bit arbitrary; lamp bottom.
Funchal: lido from above, blue loungers on sunbaked platform, sea filling 2/3. Graphic, sunbathers small; strong sea texture. Cloud bank flat. Railings bottom-left busy.
Funchal: pergola framing sea, #JACKSONANDME frog sculpture, shadows on calçada. Clean, graphic, calm; a bit empty, the sculpture too small to matter.
Funchal: steep cobbled street, jacaranda in bloom right, red scooter, cars, city on hills beyond. Good depth and colour; dark wall left heavy, parked cars clutter. Best of the jacaranda streets?

Funchal: looking between yellow walls down to café under jacaranda, sea and tetrapods beyond. Nice framing, colour; hydrant and person cut bottom-right; walls take a lot. Pair with 9676 (same place?).
Funchal: flags (Madeira, Portugal, EU) on poles above fortress wall, red hibiscus. Colourful but cluttered; crates bottom-left, flags limp.

Funchal: Fortaleza de São Tiago from the shore, swimmers on the lido platform, dark basalt wall left, sea. Good establishing seafront frame, human scale; heavy dark wall left third, flat cloud. Landscape.

Funchal: Largo by Mercado dos Lavradores, orange-flowering tree (African tulip), café crowd, heads cut bottom-left, orange flower intruding right. Busy; the tree is lovely but the foreground heads ruin the bottom.

Funchal Mercado dos Lavradores from above: fruit and veg crates around a tree trunk, black/white calçada pattern, shoppers. Rich colour, pattern, life; top-down works. Tree trunk splits frame but anchors it. Umbrella edges right. Best market frame.
Funchal: indoor gallery/market arcade, hanging plants, "Welcome" sign. Pleasant symmetry, but cluttered with signage; a record.
Funchal: Avenida Arriaga area square, calçada meander pattern, lamp post with red flowers, white building, walkers. Bright, colourful, the pattern carries; cluttered bottom (bollards, road).
Funchal: Praça do Município, Igreja do Colégio, checkerboard calçada, woman in red walking in. Clean establishing city frame; woman in red is a nice accent. Cars and taxi clutter. Landscape.
Funchal: Praça do Município fountain, scalloped calçada waves filling foreground, cypresses. Graphic pattern; good. Fountain a bit dark. Twin role with 9708 — one or both?
Funchal: Jardim Municipal, jacaranda over flowerbeds, bench, path. Pleasant, colourful; mossy path heavy at bottom, busy.
Jardim Municipal: red salvia close-up, shallow depth, layers of red. Saturated, pleasing; generic flower frame. Wins its run (9714/9720/9715/9721).

Jardim Municipal: flowerbeds with cineraria, tree trunk left, photographer (older woman) with camera left. Rich, layered; busy, no single subject. The photographer is a nice touch but small. Landscape.
Funchal: looking up at jacaranda canopy over peeling old houses, palm. Purple against cloud; dense, a bit chaotic. Different from street jacarandas. 4:5.

Funchal Avenida Arriaga: jacaranda over café umbrellas, Golden Gate building, woman in pink walking across the calçada in the foreground. Layered, colour echo (pink/purple), the walker makes it. Neat. Best jacaranda frame.
Funchal: Palácio de São Lourenço round tower, Portuguese flag, bare frangipani, low angle. Clean, bright; tree in front a bit messy but adds texture.
Funchal seafront: yellow bus and taxi frame the colourful "Funchal" letters sign, palms, tourists. Fun, bright, a bit busy; flag pole right. Street record with humour.
Funchal: Avenida Arriaga under jacarandas, people walking, yellow taxis. Nice colour; bottom 1/3 empty pale paving. Wins over 9730. Overlaps 9719 in subject.

Funchal: Praia Formosa / Zona Velha beach of pebbles, town on the hill, breakwater, cloud. Establishing of Funchal from the beach; pebbles bottom 1/3 a bit heavy. Clean horizon. Good opener candidate.
São Vicente area: steep green peak over a yellow house, banana plants, blue sky. Shows scale of the mountains; foreground clutter (gate post, bush) bottom. Tilted-feeling but verticals of house ok.

Serra de Água valley from above: terraced slopes, road snaking up the gorge into cloud, houses, green bridge. Big, deep, very Madeira. Busy foreground road/bridge at bottom-right a small blemish. Strong establishing for the valley.
São Vicente: orange roofs foreground, hillside chapel (white tower) on the slope, cloud. Pleasant, layered; the chapel small. Foreground roofs a bit messy.
São Vicente: terraced village on hillside below clouded peaks, landscape. Even light, good detail; flatter than 9763. Group 9763/9756/9757.
São Vicente: valley vertical, road and terraces, peak in cloud cap. Good depth; lots of grey cloud top. Group.

frames.focusAt: the agapanthus in front is out of focus at any size; focus went to the valley
frames.critique: São Vicente: the valley opening to the sea between two dark slopes, town at the mouth, agapanthus in front right. Strong V framing, calm grey sea; agapanthus anchors foreground (soft? check). Overcast flat sky.

Capela de Nossa Senhora de Fátima(?) clock tower at dusk, string lights, woman (companion) walking toward camera, face clearly readable. Nice light and tower; but the companion's face reads — per rule, out unless they agree. Pole right intrudes.
São Vicente: terraced village in sun under clouded peaks, landscape, light patches. Best of the trio: side light makes the terraces; good layering.
São Vicente (chapel garden?): two agapanthus heads against dark blurred forest. Clean subject separation, nice blue; a pair works. Generic but well done.
São Vicente: tabby cat peering under a crossed wooden fence, eyes on camera. Great framing by the X, warm eyes; a real moment. Grass bright. Fits "around" more than a chapter.
(posted) São Vicente coast at dusk: dark cliff left with road gallery, boulder beach, warm horizon, layered cloud. Moody, balanced; shadows heavy but fine. Pair of 9776.

frames.focusAt: the peak's ridge; some dusk noise
frames.critique: (posted, cover of "Coastal mood") São Vicente coast road at dusk: pointed peak, surf, empty road and lamp posts right, pastel cloud. Strong, cinematic; road adds story. Clean.
Véu da Noiva waterfall falling down the sea cliff, coastline receding, teal surf. Classic view done well, good depth; flat grey sky. Waterfall small but clear.

Seixal natural pool from above: two swimmers in dark still water, waves crashing beyond the basalt wall, nasturtiums in the foreground. Great contrast calm/rough, tiny swimmers give scale. Foreground greenery maybe too much.
Seixal: village roofs, the coast and huge green cliffs, Véu da Noiva thread visible, silver sea. Grand, layered, establishing; railing at bottom intrudes (blemish).

frames.focusAt: the canopy, as sharp as fog allows
frames.critique: Fanal: lone til tree in thick fog, others ghostly behind. Atmospheric, the tree's shape carries; bottom 1/3 dull ground. Wins over 0283?

Fanal: the til tree in fog, landscape, two small hikers right, fence. Stronger shape than 0274 (full crown, spread), hikers add scale; fence posts right a slight blemish. Not a twin of 0274 really: different tree/framing — both can stay.
Fanal: inside the grove, gnarled mossy trees receding into fog, red earth. Layered depth, the archetypal Fanal; left trunk frames. Very good.
Porto da Cruz: Penha de Águia? no — the small headland with the pool, rocky beach, surf, houses, cloud. Pleasant establishing; white wall bottom-left intrudes.
Larano: trail on the ridge with a hiker group, cliffs and sea. Shows the trail, scale; harsh light, group small and cluttered. Bottom-right rock.
(posted) Larano: cliffs dropping to deep blue sea, headland beyond, purple thistles front-left, vertical. Big sky (top half cloud); vivid. Winner over 9798?
Larano: same view horizontal, more sea and cliff, less sky. Arguably better balance than 9797, but 9797 was posted. Near-twin: one only. Keep 9797 (posted) unless toss-up.

(posted) Larano: companion in orange jacket from behind on the trail, yellow flowers, cliffs and headland beyond. Classic, colour accent, path leads in. OK under people rule (from behind). Vignette visible.
Larano: cliff face in sidelight, pink/ochre rock, sea and surf below, vertical. Better light than 9797: texture of the cliff; dark foreground bottom 1/5.
Larano: tangle of branches over a fern slope. Texture, nice green, but no subject; chaotic.

(posted, cover of "Cliffside cruising") Larano: cliff plunging to sparkling sea, rocks with surf, dark leaves framing right, moody vignette edit. Strong graphic diagonal, drama; best Larano frame. Dark-leaf frame right might read as intrusion, but it works as depth.

Larano: companion from behind photographing the cliff with phone, orange jacket, blue sky. People rule: from behind, ok. Story frame; companion big in the frame, the back and backpack dominate. Branch top-left/right.
Larano: green forested slope to coast, distant sea stacks, haze. Layered, calm; similar to 9858 without the person. Wins over 9836.
Larano: man (companion? or me?) on the trail with rope railing, red-ochre cliff and sea. Shows the trail drama; harsh noon light, deep blue sky clean. Person from 3/4 back, face hidden by hood: ok.
Larano: trail lined with yellow daisies, wide-angle low, mountains. Nice foreground colour; generic. Fence post left.
Larano: Pride of Madeira (Echium) spikes in a mass on the slope, the trail cutting the cliff behind, sea right edge. Distinctive plant, rich texture, good depth.

Larano: man in profile (hood, sunglasses, beard) on the cliff edge, coastline and stacks behind. Strong composition, but his profile reads: face is part of the point. Per rule: borderline; ask. Otherwise a 4.

frames.focusAt: the companion's hat and shirt are soft, the coast behind is sharper: focus went past her
frames.critique: Larano: companion sitting from behind in orange top and hat, camera on strap, looking down the coast; yellow daisies right. Shallow focus on the person? check. Strong storytelling, colour; rule ok (from behind). Group winner over 9868/9858? It's the people version.

(posted) Larano: the coast view without people, vertical, half sky blue, rock right, daisies bottom. Clean classic; sky top 40% empty blue. Kept as posted; 9866 is the companion version. Both? They're the same view: pick one in main + one variation since the person adds a moment.

Larano: view toward Porto da Cruz and Penha de Águia, deep blue bay, green ridges, landscape. The establishing shot of the walk: where we are. Foreground bushes bottom right a bit messy; overcast top.
Larano: peach blossom branch against deep blue sea, bokeh trees. Pretty, clean; a detail frame. Slightly calendar.
(posted) Porto da Cruz under Penha de Águia, the bay and sea stack, village. Strong establishing; overcast flat sky; fern foreground bottom left.
Porto da Cruz: dirt path along the shore toward the sea stack, walkers, flowers, channel right. Nice leading line, people small; wins over 9913. A bit busy.
(posted) Porto da Cruz pebble beach, green hills, surf. Flat grey sky, heavy pebbles; posted in "Coastal mood" but weaker than 9909. 3.

Pico Ruivo area: dark ridges rising out of a sea of clouds, clear blue sky, radar dome on Pico do Arieiro. Clean, graphic; the sea of clouds is the point. Bush bottom-left intrudes slightly. Afternoon light flat on the rock.
(posted) Pico Ruivo: white dead tree against cloud-filled gorge, lit ridges, sea of clouds to horizon. Excellent layering; bottom 40% dark heather is heavy (vignetted). Group winner over 9965/9978.

(posted, cover of white trees) Pico Ruivo: lone white tree lit against dark shadowed cliff, red-lit crags above, heather foreground. Spotlit subject, strong. Foreground heather bottom-right out of focus, big.
Pico Ruivo: landscape, white tree in front of ridge, sea of clouds left. Overlaps 9963; less drama, tree off-balance. Variation at most.
(posted) Pico Ruivo: ghostly white tree in a beam of side light against dark scree, a fallen white trunk lower left. Most painterly of the set; dark, moody. Check focus on branches.
Pico Ruivo: white tree in sun over cloud-filled gorge, vertical, lots of empty blue sky. Twin of 9963 but sky-heavy; 9963 wins.
(posted) Pico Ruivo: stone steps of the trail past a dry-stone wall, white tree, low sun. Path story; contrasty, big pale sky. Posted. 3.

(posted) Pico Ruivo: sunstar behind ridge, backlit wind-bent tree, purple and green flare across frame, house at top. The flare is large; I'd call it a blemish that's become the point in the post, but on the site it reads as a technical flaw. 3.
Pico Ruivo: the rest house (Casa de Abrigo) on its crag above a sea of clouds, low sun on the slope. Clear "where we are"; half frame blue sky, foreground shadowed heather.
Pico Ruivo: summit ridge with tents (orange) on the col, sea of clouds, yellow broom foreground. Story (camping on the summit) but half blank sky; tents small.
Pico Ruivo: rest house tucked under the summit, sea of clouds filling left half, landscape. Clean, clear where we are; low sun on the ridge. Better than 9987? Different: this is the wide.

Pico Ruivo: crepuscular rays over dark ridges, Pico do Arieiro plateau beyond, person (companion) photographing at bottom-left, green flare blob. Flare is a blemish; the rays are good. Companion small, from behind: ok.
Pico Ruivo: ridges and sea of clouds, vertical, blank blue top 35%. Pleasant, but the same idea as 9998, less light.
Pico Ruivo: jagged ridges with cloud spilling through valleys, warm light on rock, landscape. Rich texture, depth; rocky foreground bottom-left busy.

frames.focusAt: the figure; the rays are haze
frames.critique: Pico Ruivo: man in hood sitting from behind on rocks facing sun rays streaming across the valleys and peaks. Light rays are spectacular; the figure gives scale and mood. Rule ok (from behind). Strong candidate.

frames.focusAt: the crags; noise in the shadows
frames.critique: Pico Ruivo at sunset: sea of clouds flowing between dark peaks, orange horizon, warm side light on crags. Painterly, the cloud motion is the point. A guard wire crosses the bottom-right corner (blemish; clone?).
(posted) Pico Ruivo: companion in yellow jacket on the edge, looking down into the red-lit crags, ocean of cloud at horizon. Yellow pops, scale; face too small to recognise: ok. Sky blank.
Pico Ruivo sunset: silhouettes of the crowd on the summit ridge, sun in haze, sea of clouds. Story of the crowd; bottom 40% black, guide ropes visible. 0031 better.
Pico Ruivo sunset: silhouettes lined up on the ridge, sun low over Paul da Serra, cloud sea right. Cleaner composition than 0029, more cloud sea; bottom 1/3 black. Wins the silhouette run.
(posted, cover of "Sky on fire") Pico Ruivo: sun in the cloud bank over Paul da Serra, sea of clouds, dark peaks foreground, a ridge 'island'. Rich gradient, layered; sun blown (expected). Strong.
Pico Ruivo sunset: the crowd from behind watching the sun, sun flare, guide rope. Human story, warm; heads/backs dominate, busy. Ok, strangers from behind. Not as clean as 0031.
Pico Ruivo after sunset: peaks emerging from flowing cloud, warm horizon, cold blue cloud. Calm, painterly; dark bottom-right spire. Overlaps 0047/0049.

(posted) Pico Ruivo: sun touching the horizon, orange band, cloud sea, dark islands of ridge, deep foreground silhouette. Clean, classic; bottom 1/3 black. Twin-ish with 0033 (0033 has more light on the clouds). Both posted. Pick one main + maybe both.

(posted) Pico Ruivo dusk: peaks as islands in the cloud sea, pink-orange horizon, spire bottom right. Serene, strong; very similar to 0037/0049. Wins the run with 0049 as the variation? 0049 has more drama (spire, cloud flow).
Pico Ruivo dusk: cloud river flowing between peaks, lone needle in the cloud, pink sky band. The best of the dusk run: the needle and the flow make it. Foreground rocks bottom dark.
Pico Ruivo summit at blue hour: trig pillar with people, hiker in pink on the steps, rocky knoll, cloud sea. The summit itself; half the frame flat blue sky, railings. Good record, 3.
Pico Ruivo walk down: twisted silver dead trunk in the foreground leading to the rest house and the cloud sea, blue hour. Strong foreground-to-background; well-composed.
Pico Ruivo: companion from behind filming the tents on the ridge at dusk, pink sky. Story and colour; the figure is dark and central, path sign clutter. Rule ok.

frames.focusAt: the tree is mushy at 100% in the low light
frames.critique: Pico Ruivo: wind-bent tree on bare scree, rock castle behind, blue hour. Nice shape, mood; underexposed; soft? check.
Pico Ruivo: tree silhouette against cloud sea at dusk, dark heather bottom half. Calm; bottom half black, tree small. 3.

frames.focusAt: the branches; visible noise in the sky
frames.critique: Pico Ruivo blue hour: bare tree silhouetted against purple sky on the slope, cloud sea bottom right. Graphic, cool palette, a tree with character. Phone? (aspect 3:4 — different camera?).
Pico Ruivo: last light, layered ridge silhouettes, orange band over the cloud sea. Pretty; bottom half black. Closer for the chapter perhaps.
